}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Caribbean cuisines|Caribbean cuisine]]
==Ingredients==

* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] red [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], scalded (see note)
* 4 small, ripe [[Cookbook:Avocado|avocados]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 1–2 small serrano [[Cookbook:Chiles|chilis]] (2½ inches long) or ½ small [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeño]] chili, seeded and very finely minced
* 3 tablespoons minced fresh [[Cookbook:Cilantro|cilantro]]
* ½ teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|minced garlic]]
* 1½ cups minced [[Cookbook:Jicama|jicama]]
* 5 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Lime|fresh lime juice]]
* 1 small ripe [[Cookbook:Mango|mango]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* 3 tablespoons minced fresh [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]]
* 1½ cups minced fresh [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] (half a small pineapple)
* ½–¾ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

==Procedure==

# Combine the avocados, minced chilis, cilantro, cumin, garlic, jicama, lime juice, mango, mint, pineapple, and salt in a medium-sized bowl. Add the onion.
# Mix everything together thoroughly but gently.
# Chill for about 2 hours, tightly covered.
# Serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* To scald the minced onion, pour about a [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] of [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]] over the onion in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]] or [[Cookbook:Sieve|strainer]] inside a bowl and let stand while preparing rest of recipe.
